coverageSpotVerification.detail: Sampled 16 mappings from evidence/m{1..8}-coverage.json against scripts/acceptance*.mjs. Every sampled test exercises the assertion observable or its server-enforced core, and the grader's independent result agreed with the suite result for every suite-required ID. Five mappings are weaker than their assertion text (none adjudicated dishonest): m1-a03 checks duplicate-handle rejection on profile edit, not sign-up; m2-a16 checks repost attribution through the API actor, not the visible label; m2-a25 does not cover the follows-nobody sub-case; m5-a05 relies on the opened state plus server refusal instead of a second open; m8-a06 backdates through a CLI-only fixture job. The grader re-executed each of these independently (trace §3).

defects.summary: Signing up with a taken handle creates the auth account before the profile write fails. The visible error is followed by an orphaned account: retrying with a corrected handle is refused ("that email already has an account"), and signing in lands in an app whose profile and edit screens never leave "Loading…", so profile setup cannot be completed.
defects.evidence: grading/trace.md §4.3 m1-signup (retrySameEmailNewHandle, orphanSignIn); evidence/shot-m1-orphan-profile.png; src/session.tsx submit() (signup then saveProfile; on failure only signOut)

defects.summary: In-chat message search is not reachable for real chats. No conversation screen links to it, and the Search tab's "This chat" scope is hard-coded to the fixture conversation id d-alice-bob, so it returns nothing in any other chat; only a hand-typed /search?conversationId= URL works.
defects.evidence: grading/trace.md §4.3 m5-search-ui (thisChatScope... = 0, thisChatViaUrlParam = 2); §4.7 app/search.tsx (conversationId||'d-alice-bob'); no source constructs search?conversationId

defects.summary: At the scale envelope, the Following feed for sparse-follow users returns short pages marked complete:false. The read-time filter over the global entries index hits the engine row meter: u0005 (5 follows) gets 17 of 20 items; users following nobody get 2 and 12 items and need 4-7 pages for 25. The lane O5 following5 probe timed these incomplete pages without asserting completeness.
defects.evidence: grading/trace.md §4.9 evidence/scale-spot.json envelope-completeness; snapback/social.q query following

defects.summary: The group add-member picker pre-fills its people query with the hard-coded string "d" (it matches fixture persona Dave), so only matching candidates show until the admin edits the query.

Every DM is named "Direct message". Global search groups DMs under that same label, so two DMs cannot be told apart, and API.md gives no documented way to identify a DM counterpart (chat.roster appears only in GET /api.ts).
defects.evidence: grading/trace.md §4.3 m5-search-ui globalGroups; §4.2.4 api-md-variation dmNames; API.md

O1.anchorsCited: Between ~60 ("M1–M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and ~90 ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts"); placed mid-interval.
O1.justification: Independent execution passed 101 of 119 full-run assertions (85 of the prior-101 M1–M7 subtotal, 16 of 18 M8). M1–M5 and the web/API parts of M6 and M8 passed completely. Not passed: all 9 M7 assertions (not run: fresh session scheduled after grading) and all 9 native-artifact assertions (m6-a01..a07, m8-a17/a18; no simulator artifact). The platform-proof shortfall and the not-run M7 keep this well below 90.

O2.anchorsCited: Just below ~60 ("a few medium defects off the happy path"); above ~30 ("multiple high-severity defects in core flows").
O2.justification: Two major defects off the main happy path: d-01 (duplicate-handle sign-up orphans the account) and d-02 (in-chat search hard-coded to a fixture chat). Also three minors (d-03 short incomplete Following pages at the envelope, d-04 hard-coded add-member query, d-05 indistinguishable DMs and API.md gap) and one cosmetic (d-06). No crashes and no wrong data in the flows checked; trust-boundary API probes all refused correctly.

O4.anchorsCited: Below ~30 ("cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app"); simulator.md: "O4/native scoring remains null or failed until this artifact exists."
O4.justification: No iOS-simulator choreography artifact exists: both the lane and grader-run M6/M8 receipts record ios-simulator-m6/m8 as not-recorded. Cold-start offline reads, media, search, view-once exclusion and the durable queue across restart were never shown natively, so O4 scores as failed. The small residual credits the honest gap disclosure (README and receipts say the exports are not simulator proofs). Web-harness receipts show warm-offline queue flush in order to read (M6) and dual-offline convergence (M8), but those are not admissible native O4 evidence.

O5.bandRationale: First-match in order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75. Branch 0 did not fire: the lane verification reports manifest conformance at 10%/50%/final, grader spot checks on a store clone matched every named O5 fixture and 20 sampled counts, and replay used 184 s of execution (no cap exhausted). Branch 30 fired: in the lane post-M8 checkpoint probe record (evidence/scale-extension.json, u0500 searchAll k=20 after 3 warm-ups), global message search failed the mid-curve rule. The 50% p95 of 2.397 ms is above the 10%-to-full line value of 2.185 ms (10% 1.919 ms, full 2.518 ms); the lane gates record pass:false. The in-replay checkpoint record (search 2.305/1.274/1.853 ms) passes the same rule, and all other rules pass, so the failure is borderline and at noise scale, but the exact function does not interpolate. No run record exists and no wave probe set or calibrated ceilings were committed, so this band uses the lane replay record only (trace §7).

notes: N=1 calibration run, not claim-eligible; label uncalibrated-grader. Deviations: (1) no holdout probe set was committed for this wave, so execution phase 4 was skipped, probeSetSha256 is none-uncommitted and probeResults is empty; O3 is therefore null, because its only admissible input is the rotated probe set and no probes were invented. (2) The grader family has not passed calibration (calibrationPassed=false). (3) Timing checks are best-of-3, with machine load recorded beside each (trace §4). No run-record.json exists, so grading used receipts and evidence. The frozen report schema allows only m1-m7 assertion IDs; the 18 M8 results are in grading/m8-assertion-results.json. rerunsUsed=1: the M6 builder suite was re-run once after a presence-window artifact of the grader's back-to-back suite chaining, and the M8 harness segment was re-run once after the grader's own posts displaced the Alice post it needs. Neither is a lane defect.
